'''Noneen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Hijado]]. When [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Parlay Thorp]] arrived on Hijado to provide relief and medical assistance to the [[Hijadoan]]s after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had bombarded several cities on Hijado, Noneen greeted her and thanked her for her assistance.<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />
